description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vizier of Many Faces dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Vizier of Many Faces leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Vizier of Many Faces from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
